components.name: Primary Action
components.description: The single dominant action on an operational decision surface.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 34px; padding: 0 15px; border: 0; border-radius: var(--ag-radius-sm, 8px); color: #fafafa; background: var(--ag-brand, #06b6d4); font: 500 14px/22px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #22d3ee; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ag-brand-glow, rgba(6,182,212,.35)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: scale(.98); background: #0891b2; }

components.name: Default Action
components.description: Neutral secondary action that keeps the primary decision unambiguous.
components.css: .ds-btn-default { height: 34px; padding: 0 15px; border: 1px solid var(--ag-border, rgba(63,63,70,.65)); border-radius: var(--ag-radius-sm, 8px); color: var(--ag-text, #e4e4e7); background: var(--ag-surface-solid, #141417); font: 500 14px/22px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), background-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-default:hover { border-color: var(--ag-brand, #06b6d4); background: var(--ag-surface-hover, rgba(39,39,42,.55)); } .ds-btn-default:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ag-brand-glow, rgba(6,182,212,.35)); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-default:active { transform: scale(.98); }

components.name: Repository Search
components.description: Compact outlined input for searching names, coordinates, and digests.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 6px; color: var(--ag-text-mute, #8f8f9a); font: 500 12px/20px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-field input { height: 34px; padding: 4px 11px; border: 1px solid var(--ag-border, rgba(63,63,70,.65)); border-radius: var(--ag-radius-sm, 8px); color: var(--ag-text, #e4e4e7); background: var(--ag-surface-solid, #141417); font: 400 14px/22px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1), box-shadow 180ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-field input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ag-brand, #06b6d4); outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 2px var(--ag-brand-glow, rgba(6,182,212,.35)); }

components.name: Operational Card
components.description: Grounded work surface with structural rather than decorative elevation.
components.html:
REPOSITORY HEALTH
Ready

PostgreSQL and object storage are reachable.
components.css: .ds-card { padding: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--ag-border-subtle, rgba(63,63,70,.35)); border-radius: var(--ag-radius, 10px); color: var(--ag-text, #e4e4e7); background: var(--ag-surface-solid, #141417); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgba(0,0,0,.35), 0 4px 16px -8px rgba(0,0,0,.4); font: 400 14px/22px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-label { margin-bottom: 8px; color: var(--ag-text-mute, #8f8f9a); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-card strong { display: block; color: var(--ag-text-strong, #fafafa); font-size: 16px; } .ds-card p { margin: 4px 0 0; color: var(--ag-text-dim, #b4b4bd); }

components.name: Selected Navigation Item
components.description: Current location with a restrained wash and a narrow signal edge.
components.css: .ds-nav-selected { position: relative; display: flex; height: 38px; align-items: center; gap: 10px; padding: 0 12px; border-radius: var(--ag-radius-sm, 8px); color: #a5f3fc; background: linear-gradient(90deg, rgba(6,182,212,.14), rgba(6,182,212,.05)); font: 500 14px/22px Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-selected::before { position: absolute; top: 20%; bottom: 20%; left: 0; width: 2px; border-radius: 2px; background: var(--ag-brand, #06b6d4); content: ""; } .ds-nav-selected:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--ag-brand-glow, rgba(6,182,212,.35)); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Metric Strip
components.description: Compact page summary with tabular values and explicit semantic tone.
components.css: .ds-metric { min-width: 0; padding: 14px 20px; border: 1px solid var(--ag-border-subtle, rgba(63,63,70,.35)); border-radius: var(--ag-radius, 10px); color: var(--ag-text, #e4e4e7); background: var(--ag-surface-solid, #141417); font-family: Inter, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-metric span { display: block; color: var(--ag-text-mute, #8f8f9a); font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500; letter-spacing: .04em; } .ds-metric strong { display: block; margin-top: 4px; color: var(--ag-text-strong, #fafafa); font-size: 20px; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; letter-spacing: -.02em; } .ds-metric small { display: block; margin-top: 2px; color: var(--ag-text-dim, #b4b4bd); font-size: 12px; line-height: 20px; }

narrative.overview: Artifact Gateway Console should feel like the control surface for a system whose claims can be proved. The visual language is dark, precise, operational, and quiet: real status, immutable identity, policy boundaries, and recoverable actions receive attention before decoration. The interface is an Operate surface where density, scanability, predictable Ant Design behavior, keyboard access, and fast state feedback outrank spectacle.

rules.name: The Signal Rarity Rule
rules.body: Cyan is reserved for action, location, focus, and trusted system links; it should not become a general decorative fill.

rules.name: The Status Has Words Rule
rules.body: Success, warning, and error colors must be paired with text, an icon, or both.

rules.name: The Evidence Is Monospace Rule
rules.body: Use monospace only where exact character identity matters.

rules.name: The Twelve-Pixel Floor Rule
rules.body: Ten- or eleven-pixel text is reserved for non-essential marks only.

rules.name: The Parent Owns Rhythm Rule
rules.body: Direct page children have no external vertical margin; the page stack owns spacing.

rules.name: The Geometry Is Evidence Rule
rules.body: Responsive acceptance uses DOM rectangles, overflow assertions, and desktop/mobile screenshots.

rules.name: The Flat-Until-Raised Rule
rules.body: Large shadows appear only when a component has actually moved above its context.

dos: Do preserve real API data, protocol deep links, copy commands, immutable identities, and format-specific operations when refining a surface.
Do use Ant Design components and tokens before creating a custom primitive.
Do keep async and authorization states explicit.
Do verify responsive geometry and real browser behavior.
donts: Don't turn the Console into a generic card-and-table admin template.
Don't fabricate operational data or release status.
Don't use transition-all, animate layout properties, or replay page entrances during frequent administration.
Don't introduce a second component, toast, or motion library when Ant Design and CSS already cover the interaction.
